The available healthcare Q&A matches indicate that evidence-based practice (EBP) is associated with better patient outcomes. A study found that the EBP unit was linked to improved patient outcomes and more efficient performance compared to the same physicians previously or concurrently.

While some sub-questions explore individual factors such as uniformity of evidence-based treatments, increased patient awareness, and perspective-taking in medical encounters, they conclude that a comprehensive approach incorporating EBP is crucial for improving patient satisfaction and care.
